texts:
Thursday's practice reports are in, and the Week 5 picture got clearer in a few spots and murkier in others.

Lamar Jackson missed again.

Ja'Marr Chase is back in pads.

Ashton Jeanty picked up a foot injury.
#RavensFlock #WhoDey #RaiderNation

Lamar Jackson missed a second straight practice Thursday with the left ankle. Tyler Huntley ran the first team again.

Jackson is QB2 rest of season for me; hold him. Monitor; Friday's injury report.

Huntley is QB28 for me @ATL, outside my top 12.
#RavensFlock

Zay Flowers was limited Wednesday and Thursday with a foot injury, a correction to yesterday's report of a missed practice with the hamstring.

WR9 for me this week @ATL. Monitor; Friday's injury report.
#RavensFlock

Ja'Marr Chase was back at practice Thursday in full pads, but he is still in the concussion protocol and needs a full practice to clear.

WR45 for me @MIA until he clears. Monitor; Friday's practice and his clearance.
#WhoDey

Tee Higgins worked on the rehab field again Thursday, a second straight day without practice, with the Week 6 bye next.

Monitor; Friday's injury report.

Dohnte Meyers is WR48 for me, a dart throw that grows only if Chase sits too.
#WhoDey

Kyle Monangai missed a second straight practice. A turf toe report says one to two weeks; the coach calls it soreness from 30 carries.

RB18 for me @GB if he plays, an RB2. Monitor; Friday's injury report.
#DaBears

D'Andre Swift returned Thursday, limited with the hip and knee. He is the lead back if Monangai sits.

RB13 for me @GB, borderline RB1/RB2 this week, and higher if Monangai is out.
#DaBears #GoPackGo

Malik Nabers was back at practice Thursday, limited with the knee after sitting Wednesday.

WR10 for me this week @WAS.

Cam Skattebo shed the red non-contact jersey, still limited with the shoulder. RB19 for me, an RB2.
#NYGiants

Terry McLaurin missed Thursday's practice with the hamstring, his second straight day out.

WR29 rest of season for me. Monitor; Friday's injury report.

Stefon Diggs has conflicting reports. WR23 for me if he plays, a WR2.
#RaiseHail

Alvin Kamara went from no practice Wednesday to limited Thursday with the back.

RB25 for me vs MIN, a high-end RB3 and a high-end flex play.

Tyler Shough practiced in full with the left hand. QB12 for me, a borderline start.
#Saints

Chris Olave was limited Thursday, and New Orleans added a foot injury to Wednesday's rest day.

WR7 for me vs MIN. Monitor; Friday's injury report.
#Saints

Justin Jefferson was limited for a second day with the ankle. WR6 rest of season for me. Monitor; Friday's injury report.

Jordan Addison was limited too. WR25 for me @NO, a high-end WR3, with a smaller share if Jefferson plays.
#Skol

Ashton Jeanty went from full Wednesday to limited Thursday, with a foot injury added to the ankle.

RB11 for me @NE, borderline RB1/RB2. Monitor; Friday's injury report.

Mike Washington Jr. is next at RB37, a low-end flex play to a dart throw.
#RaiderNation

Jalen Nailor sat Thursday still in the concussion protocol and is trending toward missing @NE.

Tre Tucker is WR36 for me, a low-end WR3.

Brock Bowers practiced in full. TE2 for me this week.
#RaiderNation

Rhamondre Stevenson was limited with the knee after 35 snaps to TreVeyon Henderson's 25 at BUF. RB24 for me vs LV, an RB2.

Mack Hollins missed again with the calf. Romeo Doubs is WR27 for me, a high-end WR3.
#NEPats #RaiderNation

Sean Payton takes a bigger hand in Denver's play calls @LAC. Bo Nix is QB13 for me, a borderline start.

Ladd McConkey missed Wednesday with the foot and is week to week. WR33 for me if he plays. Monitor; Friday's injury report.
#BroncosCountry #BoltUp

Philadelphia traded Cam Jurgens to Baltimore a day after Lane Johnson retired, so London vs JAX comes with two new linemen.

Jalen Hurts is QB15 for me this week, a streamer, and QB9 rest of season. Hold him.
#FlyEaglesFly #RavensFlock

Rico Dowdle is on track to return vs IND after Jaylen Warren played 69 of 71 snaps @CLE.

Warren is RB8 for me this week.

Breece Hall is week to week with the quad. Braelon Allen took all 14 back carries @CHI and is RB20 for me, an RB2.
#HereWeGo #JetUp

Friday's injury reports settle most of this, and every call from today is on the Pass page now. Follow @FF_ChefHazy for Friday's designations, and repost this for the group chat that still has Lamar in a lineup.

https://fantasykitchenff.com/pass.html
